summary: @Medium was the startup that was open enough. You could map to your own domain, they used open APIs. They got the web, but funny thing when you take lots of money people expect lots of money back. I pulled away when I knew the math wasn't sustainable
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@Medium was the startup that was open enough. You could map to your own domain, they used open APIs. They got the web, but funny thing when you take lots of money people expect lots of money back.

I pulled away when I knew the math wasn't sustainable
